# عون الدرب للنقل المتخصص — https://aunaldrb.com/
#
# The whole site is one public page and every word of it is meant to be found.
# Nothing here is disallowed, because there is nothing to hide: the
# development material (ux/, seo/, build.js, brand/*.md, the design-system
# pages, the image masters) is never uploaded at all — see DEPLOY.md — so a
# Disallow line for those paths would only tell a crawler they exist.
#
# The named groups below are declarative. A crawler that matches its own name
# uses ITS group and ignores the wildcard one, so each is spelled out in full
# rather than left to inherit. Search and AI assistants are both welcome: this
# is a service business whose customers ask for it by description, and being
# quotable by an assistant is the same thing as being findable.

# ── everything else ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# ── search engines ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /

User-agent: Googlebot-Image
Allow: /

User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot
Allow: /

User-agent: DuckDuckBot
Allow: /

User-agent: YandexBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Slurp
Allow: /

# ── AI assistants and their indexes ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Google-Extended and Applebot-Extended are not crawlers. They are the opt-out
# switches for Gemini and Apple Intelligence: a Disallow here removes this site
# from those assistants' answers without affecting search ranking. Allowed, on
# purpose.
User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /

Allow: /

Allow: /
